snippet.title: Tiger-Heli: 40th Anniversary Edition - Atari 7800 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Captured via Atari 2600+

Defend the skies in a challenging, 7800 adaptation of an arcade classic. This vertically scrolling shooter game was first released in 1985 as an arcade game, and has been ported to numerous other consoles, but never an Atari… until now. You’re in command of a highly-maneuverable helicopter with a mission to destroy enemies and collect points. Fly through 4 vertical stages and collect Mini-Helis along the way to boost your firepower.

Tiger-Heli (C) Tatsujin
Original arcade game by Toaplan
Ported to Atari 7800 by Bruno Steux
POKEY Music Conversion by Maxime Steux
Published by Atari Interactive / PLAION
